document.name: Queens Taekwon-Do Center Jackson Heights
document.shortDescription: Jackson Heights taekwondo program with weekday children’s classes and a weekend youth group.
document.longDescription:
Queens Taekwon-Do Center's official history and class schedule pages place the school at 89-18 Roosevelt Avenue in Jackson Heights with phone 718-639-6998 and email mastersuarez@qtc-itf.com. The official site describes a long-running program focused on junior students and says the school currently offers flexible hours for both adults and children.

The reviewed official search results also state that QTC teaches four children's classes from Monday to Friday and runs an additional weekend group for students who can only attend on weekends. That is enough to support weekday and weekend availability without inventing more specific time-of-day tags.

Sources: https://www.qtc-itf.com/class-schedule https://www.qtc-itf.com/our-history https://www.qtc-itf.com/copy-of-our-rules https://static.wixstatic.com/media/85abaa_feb571b00e3148969e240c6034c96951~mv2.jpg/v1/crop/x_0,y_103,w_2480,h_3296/fill/w_643,h_855,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/QTC_2026_POSTER%20(1).jpg
